builds.notes: Published release asset: Snap64Recomp-1.1.2-linux-arm64.tar.gz. Native static recompilation of the Nintendo 64 Pokémon Snap game (not emulation). Requires your own legally obtained US Pokémon Snap cartridge dump; no ROM included. ARM64 build produced by GitHub ARM runner but publisher says real ARM64 hardware gameplay NOT yet tested. Needs Vulkan 1.2 and other desktop dependencies; Steam Frame untested.
